determinism: Matches are deterministic for (wasm A, wasm B, map); re-running a cell or changing a seed does not create an independent sample. Uncertainty uses maps as clusters.

engine.fuel: official default; the CLI fuel override flag is forbidden

framework_checks.what: sha256 of references/builds/*.wasm equal manifest.json and protocol

framework_checks.pass_rule: replay member, both .fuel members, stdout members and summary.json byte-identical for every repeat
framework_checks.what: same (wasm A, wasm B, map) run twice in separate folders

framework_checks.pass_rule: replay.repl26a and summary.json byte-identical on every cell; .fuel members reported (expected identical when the code section equals the original)
framework_checks.what: all heads off vs the original reference cells

framework_checks.pass_rule: replay.repl26a and summary.json byte-identical on every cell (identical actions); per-turn fuel overhead reported from .fuel members
framework_checks.what: all heads shadow, zero residual, kFuelCredit

framework_checks.pass_rule: MEASUREMENT, not pass/fail: cells with divergent replays, first divergent round, outcome flips, margin deltas and fuel overhead are reported, never hidden
0 bot faults, 0 diagnostics codes, 0 invalid actions and per-head call/fallback/budget counters present in NFT1 telemetry; win rates are NOT evaluated
framework_checks.what: every head active with seeded untrained weights (plumbing only)

framework_checks.pass_rule: 0 faults; with kFuelCredit identical replays; without credit divergence measured as in neutral_real
framework_checks.profile: per-head shadow builds (one head shadow, rest off)

framework_checks.what: tools/verify_release.py on the packaged release ZIP

framework_checks.pass_rule: release: fuelExhausted entries <= 1.25x original + 4 on the scenario cells; per-turn p99/p99.9/max reported; dev: per-head fuel and budget refusals reported; low-fuel fallback additionally covered by native budget tests (B)
framework_checks.what: typical, many entities, crowded combat, late game, low fuel

framework_checks.label: untrained framework check
framework_checks.pass_rule: all cells complete, 0 faults; results reported as untrained-framework checks, never as learning or strength evidence
framework_checks.what: vs original, v47, first-hour, both sides

ledger.rule: one final evaluation per candidate sha256 and per candidate family; a second requires a recorded reason (>= 20 chars) and is reported
